name: Trusted Redirect
description: Allows redirects to trusted external hosts.
project_description:
Drupal by default does not allow redirects to external destinations that are triggered via the ?destination=target URL parameter. 

 This module introduces a configurable list of trusted external hosts to which redirects are permitted. Since version 1.8 the module covers every redirect issued by Drupal, including redirects triggered by the destination parameter.
